injury_provenance_note: Official 2PM injury PDF text parsed; screenshot fetch failed cache. Team association checked via explicit header; no interpretation of QUESTIONABLE as OUT, current POR NOT YET SUBMITTED is not equivalent to full availability.
scouting_policy: Deep dive targets one or two matchup-specific mechanisms; pregame evidence and counterarguments separate; no fabricated player impacts/minutes. Preserve this file even if post-model analyst differs. No Model C inference yet.

games.research_question: Can Toronto repeat its 15 Nov paint advantage while protecting a lead against New York's Brunson/Towns two-man closing actions?
games.mechanism: Towns rebounding and Brunson's late-game ball-screen creation give NYK a plausible late-possession answer, even if Toronto can put mobile finishers into the paint; Toronto struggled to contain Knicks' late comeback on the immediately preceding meeting.
games.independent_evidence: 15 Nov NYK win 112-108 in OT after 13-point Q4 deficit; Towns 28/17, Brunson 28, Barnes 30. Toronto's Barnes now QUESTIONABLE due illness, not confirmed OUT. Opponent scouting specifically notes Toronto attacking NYK paint and Knicks pick-and-roll coverage questions.
games.counterargument: Toronto previously built a significant lead and found efficient downhill/paint routes with Barnes and other forwards; if Barnes plays and Toronto sustains point-of-attack pressure, previous NYK clutch finish may not repeat.
games.role_or_rotation_uncertainty: Scottie Barnes QUESTIONABLE; availability at pretip unknown.

games.research_question: Can depleted Detroit frontcourt/spacing keep Wembanyama from anchoring help at the rim while maintaining its usual offensive rebounds?
games.mechanism: With Duren OUT and Robinson OUT, Detroit loses a key interior finisher/rebounder and perimeter threat. Wembanyama can protect the rim/help on drives while Spurs' offensive creation via Fox/Castle/Harper pressures Detroit replacements.
games.independent_evidence: Official 2pm ET report names DET Duren, Holland, Isaiah Joe, Duncan Robinson OUT; San Antonio Tobias Harris OUT. Detroit preview projects Cade, Jenkins, Ausar, Collins and Paul Reed against Fox, Harper, Castle, Vassell and Wembanyama. Wembanyama's cited seasonal shot-blocking and interior scoring support this as a targeted matchup, not generic team ORtg.
games.counterargument: Cade/Ausar pressure, Collins/Paul Reed activity and Spurs' potential fouling/turnovers could offset Detroit's absent center; actual replacement minutes uncertain.
games.role_or_rotation_uncertainty: John Collins/Paul Reed frontcourt minute split unverified; no individual on/off or DARKO impacts validated.

games.research_question: Will MIN's wing-depth and Gobert interior defense reproduce Monday's win, or can POR adjust to Terrence Shannon's exceptional scoring in an immediate same-arena rematch?
games.mechanism: Both coaches have immediate film and no travel. Minnesota can still play through Gobert's rim defense and improved wing self-creation by Shannon, but losing Anthony Edwards/DiVincenzo/Kuminga reduces offensive insulation and the fresh 34-point Shannon outing may be non-repeatable.
games.independent_evidence: 16 Nov Wolves won 106-98 despite Edwards absence; Shannon posted career-high 34 and Deni Avdija scored 27; former Minnesota assistant Micah Nori coaches Portland and knows Wolves concepts. Latest official Minnesota report lists Edwards, DiVincenzo, Kuminga, Clark OUT. Portland current 17 Nov official report NOT YET SUBMITTED.
games.counterargument: Portland coaching adjustment and Avdija attacking the absence of Minnesota wings may matter; cannot assume yesterday's singular 34-point scorer repeats or that Portland absences carry forward without fresh report.
games.role_or_rotation_uncertainty: Portland current report not submitted; exclude unverified same-day POR OUT tags. Minnesota key wing absences confirmed.

games.research_question: Will Utah's young guard-led offense create enough rim pressure against Brook Lopez while lacking its entire primary scoring/spacing frontcourt?
games.mechanism: Utah Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr and Nurkic OUT takes away key frontcourt spacing, shot blocking and size. Clippers can use Darius Garland's pick-and-roll with stretch big Lopez, whose shooting pulls thin Jazz interior helpers out; Jazz relies on Keyonte George and Darryn Peterson perimeter creation.
games.independent_evidence: Official 2PM ET injury sheet confirms Utah three frontcourt OUT; Clippers Brandon Ingram and Bradley Beal OUT as well. Team preview documents Garland and Lopez roles, young Keyonte George/Peterson guard usage, and possible Utah Mo Bamba lineup.
games.counterargument: Clippers remain without two substantial scorers and are a weak finishing/rotation team; Utah perimeter creation and Bamba's size can keep matchup competitive. No validated matchup possessions or player-on/off numbers.
games.role_or_rotation_uncertainty: Rotations young and unstable; reported projected lineups are not confirmed starts.

games.research_question: Can Charlotte's long/active wings force Luka into passes and punish Kessler's absence with interior activity, or does the Lakers' Luka-centered half-court creation still dominate?
games.mechanism: Luka's high-volume ball-screen scoring and playmaking anchor Lakers even without Reaves; Charlotte has no Kon Knueppel or Schroder and weaker continuity, while Miller/White/Reid can challenge Lakers supporting defenders and send aggressive help at Luka. Walker Kessler OUT matters for rim deterrence.
games.independent_evidence: Lakers on eight-game streak, Luka ~39 pts/game per dated NBA preview. Official Lakers 2PM ET report confirms Reaves and Walker Kessler OUT, Grimes AVAILABLE; Hornets Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder OUT; Charlotte preview highlights Miller return, Coby White and Naz Reid.
games.counterargument: Reaves absence concentrates on-ball creation; trapping Luka may expose LAL other ball-handlers. Kessler absence gives Charlotte paths to attack paint; Miller's return increases perimeter shot variance.
games.role_or_rotation_uncertainty: Projected Charlotte starting five is not a confirmed lineup; Reaves and Kessler are confirmed OUT.
